payload.reason: The evidence provides clear insights into the practical applications of measuring performance using MAP at gold-k, particularly in evaluating entity search and extraction methods in user-generated text.

claims.text: Measuring MAP at gold-k helps evaluate ESE methods in scenarios with large concept sizes, improving recall estimates in real-world applications.
The MAP at gold-k metric is designed to stress test ESE methods, particularly for user-generated text, where traditional metrics may fall short.
Using MAP at gold-k allows for better representation of multifaceted, vague, and non-named entities, which are often overlooked in smaller k evaluations.
